target.title: fix: keep crabbox runtime state out of sync
target.body:
## Summary
- Keep Crabbox-owned runtime state under `.crabbox/env`, `.crabbox/scripts`, `.crabbox/logs`, `.crabbox/captures`, and `.crabbox/runs` in a final protected sync exclude set.
- Add a regression proving `.crabboxignore` negation cannot re-include tracked runtime state while repo-owned `.crabbox` files still sync.
- Document the protected runtime exclude behavior.

## Root Cause
`.crabboxignore` rules were appended after built-in excludes, so a later `!` rule could re-include Crabbox-owned runtime files. That could accidentally send forwarded env profiles, uploaded scripts, local run artifacts, or failure bundles during a later sync.

## Validation
- `go test ./internal/cli -run 'Test(CrabboxRuntimeExcludesCannotBeReincluded|CrabboxIgnoreCanReincludeDefaultExcludedSourcePath|SyncManifestUsesGitFilesAndIgnoresIgnoredJunk|SyncManifestPrunesNestedDefaultExcludes|PathExcludedUsesOrderedNegation|SyncExcludesPreservesRepeatedRuleOrder)'`
- `go test ./internal/cli`
